subject: [PATCH v3 1/7] selftests/mm: add MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT contract tests

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest harness to test the behavior of MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT hints in Linux. The tests cover basic behavior, including that neither hint populates PTE holes or faults swapped pages back in, and neither can be applied to locked VMAs. Additionally, the tests pin the process to its starting CPU to ensure accurate results. This patch is part of a larger series of patches that aim to improve the testing of memory management features in Linux.

reviews.author: Sarthak Sharma
reviews.summary: Reviewer Sarthak Sharma approved the patch, specifically mentioning that changing the selftest name and adding a swap check in main() are improvements.
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks for changing the name of the selftest. Adding the swap check once
in main() also looks good.

Reviewed-by: Sarthak Sharma <sarthak.sharma@arm.com>

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch adds contract tests for the MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT hints in the Linux kernel. The tests ensure that these hints do not populate page table holes or fault swapped pages back in, and also verify their behavior on locked VMAs. To run the tests, a kselftest harness is added to pin the process to its starting CPU, preventing LRU batch draining from affecting the test results.
